svg.title: Equal epochs favour batches of 32; equal updates do not
svg.desc: Two dot charts with one row per run of section 6, grouped as 1,000 epochs each, about 10,000 updates each and 1,000 updates each; each row a band over seeds 0 to 4 with a tick per seed and a dot for seed 0, batches of 32 in blue. Left the training loss on an axis from 0 to 1, right the test accuracy in percent from 50 to 90. 1,000 epochs each: B = 300 (1,000 epochs, 1,000 updates): training loss 0.2323, 0.5276, 0.5967, 0.4640, 0.3264; test accuracy 79.67, 70.00, 66.67, 74.00, 76.33; B = 100 (1,000 epochs, 3,000 updates): training loss 0.3242, 0.4893, 0.4787, 0.3710, 0.4333; test accuracy 79.67, 75.67, 75.67, 77.33, 76.00; B = 32 (1,000 epochs, 10,000 updates): training loss 0.3025, 0.2417, 0.2901, 0.2523, 0.3181; test accuracy 77.00, 82.00, 80.00, 79.00, 80.00. About 10,000 updates each: B = 300 (10,000 epochs, 10,000 updates): training loss 0.0874, 0.2814, 0.2916, 0.2095, 0.1260; test accuracy 82.33, 79.00, 76.00, 82.00, 84.00; B = 100 (3,334 epochs, 10,002 updates): training loss 0.1559, 0.2643, 0.3252, 0.2164, 0.2171; test accuracy 83.00, 81.67, 78.33, 79.33, 83.33; B = 32 (1,000 epochs, 10,000 updates): training loss 0.3025, 0.2417, 0.2901, 0.2523, 0.3181; test accuracy 77.00, 82.00, 80.00, 79.00, 80.00; B = 8 (264 epochs, 10,032 updates): training loss 0.5947, 0.6454, 0.6445, 0.7807, 0.7179; test accuracy 60.00, 63.33, 62.00, 54.00, 56.00. 1,000 updates each: B = 300 (1,000 epochs, 1,000 updates): training loss 0.2323, 0.5276, 0.5967, 0.4640, 0.3264; test accuracy 79.67, 70.00, 66.67, 74.00, 76.33; B = 32 (100 epochs, 1,000 updates): training loss 0.7090, 0.6733, 0.6750, 0.9024, 0.7395; test accuracy 59.33, 65.00, 67.33, 52.33, 60.33.
svg.text: Equal epochs favour batches of 32; equal updates do not
The spiral, Adam at 0.02 with decay 10−5​, seeds 0 to 4, measured forward-only after the last update.
Equal epochs: batches of 32 lead. About 10,000 updates: no order. 1,000 updates: the full batch leads.
